reply.text:
I'd skip that plan. Going without water on the day isn't a trick I'd back, because dehydration makes you weaker, foggier and slower to recover, and it's the kind of thing that goes wrong fast if you're also training or sweating. For anything that involves cutting water on purpose to make a weight class, check with a doctor, since that's a health call and not a coaching one.

What I can say in general terms is that the steady approach works better. Drink normally through the week, don't change much in the last day, and let your weight settle where your training and eating have put it.

If there's a weigh-in coming up for a meet or a class, tell me the date and what it's for, and I'll help you plan the training side around it.
